description: An audit record of a single asynchronous job, written when the job completes or fails. Its fields follow the job's status, including its full request body and selected fields of its response.

jobType.description: The type of the job, e.g., QUERY, DOWNLOAD_CSV_FROM_TABLE, AGENT_CHAT.

jobState.description: The state the job ended in: COMPLETE or FAILED.

startedBy.description: The ID of the user that started the job.

startedOn.description: When the job started, in UTC milliseconds.

changedOn.description: When the job ended, in UTC milliseconds.

runtimeMs.description: How long the job ran, in milliseconds.

exception.description: The class of the exception that failed the job.

errorMessage.description: The one line error message of a failed job.

sessionId.description: The session ID of the web-services call that started the job. Joins this record to the matching access record.

requestBody.description: The JSON of the job's request body.

responseBody.description: The JSON of the fields recorded from the job's response. For a query, these are the fields that identify an aggregate-only read and whether its counts were post-processed. Absent for other job types and for a failed job.
